topic: F2-WP-105 post-start ambiguity, retry identity and idempotency

unique_value: Pins and source-reads AWS Powertools idempotency, CloudEvents identity and Restate durable invocation donors.
Retains AWS conditional INPROGRESS/COMPLETE concurrency fencing and a current upstream fail-open expiry bug lesson.
Separates invocation_id, idempotency_key and attempt_id; recommends attach/query of the original attempt after ambiguity.
Re-enters after F2 semantic EffectRequestIdentity/request_sha256 binding became current source, so it does not duplicate the already-closed digest-binding blocker.
Adds RFC 9110 retry semantics: non-idempotent operations should not be automatically retried after response uncertainty unless idempotency or provable non-application exists.
Adds Python subprocess TimeoutExpired semantics as direct support that post-start timeout is a process-control observation, not proof that earlier world side effects did not happen.
Adds AWS Builders Library counterexample that a payload hash alone is not a retry identity because two identical requests can intentionally represent two distinct operations.

Directly maps the bound EntityOS contradiction: EffectGate converts any bridge exception to FAILED while current F2 raises ExecutorOutcomeUnknown after post-start ambiguity; EffectJournal has UNKNOWN_AFTER_RESTART but no distinct post-dispatch UNKNOWN finalization in the bound source.

current_trigger4_feedback_fused.finding: Immutable request/call to canonical effect-id correlation now has executed deterministic no-real-effect public CI component evidence. This narrows Trigger6 away from semantic digest creation and toward ambiguity/idempotency/outcome semantics.

Current source classifies ordinary exceptions after successful Popen as typed UNKNOWN/nonreplayable; exact-current execution of that specific regression remains blocked/unobserved on the private canonical checkout.

fused_conclusion.strongest_current_hypothesis: F2 should prefer a minimal native UNKNOWN-safe retry envelope over a new durable workflow/event store. Keep semantic request digest, stable retry/operation identity, invocation/attempt identity and canonical effect_id distinct. Same retry identity with a changed semantic digest fails before dispatch. Ambiguous post-start outcomes remain UNKNOWN and nonreplayable by default until authority-owned verification or an independently proven target idempotency contract closes the uncertainty.
fused_conclusion.identity_warning: Do not promote request_sha256 into the retry key. Semantic equality and operation identity are different dimensions.
fused_conclusion.authority_warning: Trigger6 source evidence does not authorize a new EntityOS journal status/schema. Any UNKNOWN_POST_DISPATCH integration is a Trigger4/current-authority design-and-test action and must retain the single EffectGate/EffectJournal lane.

next_nonduplicate_trigger6_step.question: Can existing F2 invocation_id, autonomy goal/step identity or another already-canonical field satisfy stable operation_retry_id semantics across retry/restart paths without overloading occurrence identity?
required_negative_cases: same retry id + different request digest => reject, zero dispatch
live/ambiguous original attempt => zero concurrent duplicate dispatch
intentional second identical semantic request + distinct operation id => not deduplicated
post-start timeout/ordinary exception => UNKNOWN, no negative world fact
UNKNOWN non-idempotent effect => no automatic replay
replay only after proven idempotency or authoritative non-application verification
